request.text: One car-to-car side collision. Sharp steel contact, short buckling grind, debris settling. No engine bed or tyre squeal. Timbre: a blunt car panel crunch followed by a quick loose bumper twang. Dirty close garage foley, springy snap, loose metal, short raw room, dangerous comic punch. 1.5 seconds. Original isolated effect; no music, no voice.
